name: Synth
description: Built, not born. Warranty long expired.
long_description: Somebody manufactured the first Synths to work the places flesh couldn't. Then somebody forgot to switch them off, and the courts have been arguing ever since. A Synth doesn't tire, doesn't sicken and doesn't drink anything a still produces - but the chassis is dense, the smile is wrong, and brewing organics is beneath their dignity anyway.
